card.text: Explore Achilles in 3D with its published shape model and documented physical size scale.

introduction.text: Published lightcurve reconstruction, sized using a stellar occultation. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: Light-curve shape model
shape.detail: Published shape · grid marks missing imagery
shape.summary: Occultation-constrained volume-equivalent diameter 131 ± 8 km. The convex model shows broad shape; rotational phase is illustrative.

elevation.title: Shape-derived elevations
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 65.5 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
